with_memory.headline: Multiple strong fraud links via same surveyor and garage
with_memory.reasoning: The claim shares a surveyor (K. Venkat Rao) and garage (Sri Balaji Auto Works) with two confirmed‑fraud claims (CLM-2026-10595 and CLM-2026-10572). Both past frauds involved identical patterns of unknown rear‑end collisions and similar damage descriptions, indicating a possible coordinated scheme. No mitigating personal‑identifier overlaps are present, and the strong links outweigh the weak approved cases.

red_flags.title: Surveyor linked to fraud

red_flags.title: Garage linked to fraud

mitigating_factors: Two prior claims with same surveyor and garage were approved and paid (e.g., CLM-2026-10502, CLM-2026-10466)
next_steps: Obtain detailed police FIR and verify vehicle damage with independent forensic assessment
Cross‑check claimant's phone and bank account against fraud watchlist
Interview the surveyor and garage manager about the claim
